# AI Music Video Guide (purposewithpresence.com)

> Independent, citation-first guides for musicians turning finished songs into AI music videos: Seedance 2.0, Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1 workflows, honest pricing math, monetization rules, and troubleshooting. Every article carries primary-source citations and FAQ schema. Facts are dated ("as of" markers) and updated on change.
